caption: Thank you Cobb County! Yall showed up multiple times this week. The work doesn't stop. Our first Flock Town Hall is Thursday.
alt: Comic-styled collage headed THANK YOU: snapshots of residents protesting at a roadside with hand-made signs, a sign-making session, a DeFlock Q and A, and a speaker presenting to a seated audience, above the words For showing up.

caption: Happy National Week of Action! Two chances to get active today: Smyrna City Council at 7, and Flock 101 at 6:30 at South Cobb Library.
alt: Video still quoting a resident to Smyrna council: You've created a deep distrust between this council and Smyrna citizens, within a mile of my home alone 37 cameras are collecting my data. Below it, footage of the council chamber and a red banner reading Come speak out at City Council today located in City Hall at 7pm.

caption: Marietta keeps filling city council to capacity over the data center projects. The city seems more focused on policing our concerns than listening to them.
alt: Hand-drawn poster of two arms holding up a placard that reads WARNING! The city of Marietta is surveilling you!

caption: A portion of Marietta's Flock contract is expiring and we need you to call it out. Email the council, then sign up for public comment.
alt: Video title card reading AUGUST 12TH CITY COUNCIL MEETING in white and green type over a dark background of surveillance camera imagery.
